precision: All coordinates, height zones, thicknesses and counts are normalized estimates, not surveyed dimensions.

features.feature: east portal, deep eave, three visual facade zones
features.basis: architect photographs 01–05 and city daytime/night exterior
features.treatment: wide pale frame; recessed blue-green upper glazing; orange-brown middle fins; lower entrance glazing. Six floors are not rendered as six equal window bands.

features.feature: north recessed screen and separate projecting glazing/core
features.basis: city daytime full-resolution northeast view; upper guides
features.treatment: distinct from south; upper bay, brown recessed zone and west-side narrow glazed core with thin cap

features.feature: south facade and southeast tall core
features.basis: architect photographs 06–07; guide outlines; roof aerial
features.treatment: long brown fins, pale horizontal ledges, genuinely open top pergola, tall pale core and narrow opaque turquoise stair strip

features.basis: registered 1F–6F guide outlines and aerial, not a west photo
features.treatment: neutral untextured surfaces; preserved indents/core/upper southwest setback; no copied windows

features.basis: 4F explicitly labels atrium; 5F/6F corresponding gray rectangle; aerial dark top region
features.treatment: shallow dark top patch and rim only; no asserted open shaft, skylight, truss, occupied room or interior depth

features.basis: east/south/north photo silhouettes plus aerial positions
features.treatment: southeast tall core, north cap, west low rectangular cap, east eave and shallow southwest region; no full extra roof storey
limited approximate raised platform, five stylized steps and ramp surface; plinth is a display aid, not a surveyed site

omissions: interior rooms and usable floor simulation
small rooftop machinery, pipework and unverified details
area_caution: 155.81 m² is the official roof-structure floor area (屋突物一層), not roof projection or roof-height evidence.
color_caution: Photographic color families are uncalibrated; glass is opaque material color, not a literal optical simulation.
